svg.text: Grozovoi and Shimakaze smokes by mode, beside Daring and Gdansk
Each line is one laid smoke, the dot its centre. Team-normalized: north-spawn teams mirrored north-south so own spawn is at the bottom. Dashed circles are caps.
Cap-sitting mode (short, parked, near a cap)
Smoke-line mode (long, moving, stacked or on a flank)
black outline = MACHX (half of all Grozovoi smokes)
